documents.title: Infinite Spin Series Ω Investor Deck

dossier.psychProfile: Dr. Elara Voss is 68% augmented with a living helical neural lattice. She has a deep philosophical rift with her sister Seraphine (Veilwalker), believing Veil’s path is 'beautiful but ultimately sterile'. Secretly maintains a hidden greenhouse of pre-collapse Earth flowers she talks to.
dossier.attackVectors: High-success social engineering lines: 1. 'Your sister Veilwalker still thinks flesh is the future. You and I both know better.' 2. Offer rare Earth seeds or botanical specimens. 3. Ask philosophical questions about humanity’s long-term survival. 4. Pretend to apply for the Gene Cradle program.
leakedMemos: Memo #HX-Ω-33719: 'Tell AetherX their ‘thrust’ is crude. We spin worlds. They merely bruise them. — HelixPrime'

rivalShade.intel: Loud children with rockets. We outgrew that phase.
My sister builds beautiful cages. We build new homes.
They calculate futures. We grow them.

quickhackVault.name: Helix Spin
quickhackVault.description: Creates a spinning gravity well that disrupts enemy targeting and pulls systems into a collapsing orbit (AoE damage + disorient). Flavor: 'Everything spins. Everything falls into rhythm.'

quickhackVault.name: Gene Cradle Override
quickhackVault.description: Temporarily rewrites enemy ICE firmware to fight for you. Flavor: 'You were never meant to be their tool.'

blackmail: Private logs of HelixPrime crying while tending her secret Earth garden.
Evidence of secret sabotage against AetherX launch windows to slow their 'crude' expansion.
dossier.executiveBackdoor: Password: SpinToWinBaby420. Special effect: Grants 'Spin Patron' perk (+25% effectiveness on adaptive/self-repairing ICE).
